name: Note Station NSX Import
changes: Save profile and Compare later backup now show how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button, when you select them.
Without Pro, these controls save no profile and read no snapshot.
tip: Keep Source snapshot.json from an import. With Pro, you can compare a later backup against it in a new review folder.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Note Station NSX Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
